# superset_role_members (Resource)

Manages the members of a role from the side of the role, on Superset 6: the users that have the role and the groups that carry it. Each list that is set is authoritative: Superset makes exactly these users or groups members, so members added elsewhere are removed on the next apply, and an empty list removes them all. A list that is unset is left alone. Destroying the resource removes the members of the lists it managed. Do not manage the same membership through `superset_user.roles` or `superset_group.roles` as well, since each side would undo the other. The role endpoints belong to the Flask-AppBuilder security API, which Superset only enables with `FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_role" "analysts" {
  name = "Analysts"
}

data "superset_user" "ana" {
  username = "ana"
}

data "superset_user" "ben" {
  username = "ben"
}

data "superset_group" "finance" {
  name = "finance"
}

# Exactly these users and groups have the Analysts role; members added in the UI are removed
# on the next apply.
resource "superset_role_members" "analysts" {
  role_id   = superset_role.analysts.id
  user_ids  = [data.superset_user.ana.id, data.superset_user.ben.id]
  group_ids = [data.superset_group.finance.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number) Identifier of the role.

### Optional

- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the groups that carry the role; exactly these groups when set.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the users that have the role; exactly these users when set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the role, which identifies the resource as well.
